use System.Math
use Raster.IMAGE

use VECTOR = (x: double, y: double, z: double)

let size = 400
let extent = 22.0

let big = (centre = (x = 0.0, y = 0.0, z = 0.0), radius = 20.0)
let small = (centre = (x = 10.0, y = 10.0, z = 18.0), radius = 14.0)

let light = (x = -0.5, y = 0.6, z = 1.0)

normalized(v: VECTOR) -> VECTOR is
    let length = Math.sqrt(v.x * v.x + v.y * v.y + v.z * v.z)

    return (x = v.x / length, y = v.y / length, z = v.z / length)
si

depths(
    centre: VECTOR,
    radius: double,
    x: double,
    y: double
) -> (hit: bool, near: double, far: double) is
    let dx = x - centre.x
    let dy = y - centre.y
    let squared = radius * radius - dx * dx - dy * dy

    if squared < 0.0 then
        return (hit = false, near = 0.0, far = 0.0)
    fi

    let half = Math.sqrt(squared)

    return (hit = true, near = centre.z - half, far = centre.z + half)
si

shade(normal: VECTOR) -> ubyte is
    let direction = normalized(light)

    let lit =
        normal.x * direction.x +
        normal.y * direction.y +
        normal.z * direction.z

    if lit < 0.0 then
        return 20ub
    fi

    return cast ubyte(20.0 + 235.0 * Math.pow(lit, 1.6))
si

axis(index: int) -> double =>
    extent * (2.0 * cast double(index) / cast double(size) - 1.0)

let image = IMAGE(size, size)

for row in 0..size do
    for column in 0..size do
        let x = axis(column)
        let y = -axis(row)

        let outer = depths(big.centre, big.radius, x, y)

        if !outer.hit then
            continue
        fi

        let crater = depths(small.centre, small.radius, x, y)

        let hollowed =
            crater.hit /\
            crater.near < outer.far /\
            crater.far > outer.far

        if hollowed /\ crater.near < outer.near then
            continue
        fi

        let centre = if hollowed then small.centre else big.centre fi
        let radius = if hollowed then small.radius else big.radius fi
        let depth = if hollowed then crater.near else outer.far fi

        let outward =
            (x = (x - centre.x) / radius,
             y = (y - centre.y) / radius,
             z = (depth - centre.z) / radius)

        let normal =
            if hollowed then
                (x = -outward.x, y = -outward.y, z = -outward.z)
            else
                outward
            fi

        let level = shade(normal)

        image.set_pixel(column, row, level, level, level)
    od
od

image.write("death-star.png")

image.show("death-star.png")
